title: Snow Sports & Winter Recreation Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=ikon:pass) OR (index=personal sourcetype=slopes:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="ikon:pass","primary",sourcetype="slopes:session","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from ikon:pass and slopes:session to see whether two snow sports feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `ikon:pass` and `slopes:session` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main snow sports data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
